newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM considers position on fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: KLM considers position on fuel surcharge.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines cannot say whether it will be dropping its cargo fuel surcharge yet, a spokesman told Reuters.
Delta Air LINES dropped its fuel surcharge yesterday.
Fuel prices are showing a slight decline, said the spokesman and KLM is studying the situation.

"The airlines had suffered high fuel prices for quite a long time before they imposed the fuel surcharges. The lowering of fuel prices does not necessarily lead to KLM immediately dropping the fuel surcharge," he added.

In October and November last year most leading airlines imposed fuel surcharges of 10 U.S. cents a kilo on air cargo rates after a steep rise in jet fuel prices but promised the surcharges would be removed when fuel prices fell back.
